panel.title: MITRE ATT&CK Tactic Coverage — Detection Fires by Category

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ | eval tactic=case( EventCode=10 AND match(TargetImage,"(?i)lsass"), "Credential Access", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(sekurlsa|comsvcs|mimikatz|secretsdump|pypykatz|nanodump|lazagne|reg\.exe.*(save|export).*(sam|system|security))"), "Credential Access", EventCode=4662, "Credential Access", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|cscript|wscript|certutil|msbuild|installutil)\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(http|ftp|\\\\\\\\|encoded|bypass|hidden)"), "Defense Evasion", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-enc|-nop|-w hidden|downloadstring|iex|invoke-expression|certutil.*decode|mshta.*javascript)"), "Execution", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(net\s+(user|group|localgroup|share|view|session)|nltest|dsquery|whoami|systeminfo|ipconfig|arp\s+-a|netstat)"), "Discovery", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(psexec|wmic.*process.*call|winrm|enter-pssession|invoke-command\s+.*-computer)"), "Lateral Movement", EventCode=13 AND match(TargetObject,"(?i)(Run|RunOnce|Services|Userinit|Shell|Winlogon)"), "Persistence", EventCode=7045, "Persistence", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(named.*pipe|token.*impersonate|potato|printspoofer|godpotato)"), "Privilege Escalation", EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4732, "Persistence", EventCode=4625, "Credential Access", EventCode=3, "Lateral Movement", EventCode=11, "Collection", 1=1, "Unclassified") | where tactic!="Unclassified" | stats count by tactic | sort -count

index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ | eval rule=case( EventCode=10 AND match(TargetImage,"(?i)lsass"), "CR-01: LSASS Access (T1003.001)", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)comsvcs.*(minidump|#24)"), "CR-02: Comsvcs LSASS Dump (T1003.001)", match(CommandLine,"(?i)(sekurlsa|privilege::debug|lsadump|invoke-mimikatz)"), "CR-03: Mimikatz (T1003)", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)reg\.exe") AND match(Image,"(?i)rundll32\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(javascript|http|vbscript|mshtml)"), "DE-01: Rundll32 Proxy Exec (T1218.011)", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)regsvr32\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(scrobj|/s|/u|/i:http)"), "DE-02: Regsvr32 Proxy (T1218.010)", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)mshta\.exe"), "DE-03: MSHTA Execution (T1218.005)", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)certutil\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(decode|urlcache|encode)"), "DE-04: Certutil Abuse (T1140)", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-enc|-encodedcommand)"), "EX-01: Encoded PowerShell (T1059.001)", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(downloadstring|invoke-webrequest|wget|curl|net\.webclient|bitstransfer)"), "EX-02: PowerShell Download (T1059.001)", panel.title: Detection Fires Over Time by Tactic

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ | eval tactic=case( EventCode=10 AND match(TargetImage,"(?i)lsass"), "Credential Access", match(CommandLine,"(?i)(sekurlsa|comsvcs|mimikatz|secretsdump)"), "Credential Access", EventCode=4662, "Credential Access", EventCode=4625, "Credential Access", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|certutil)\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(http|decode|javascript|scrobj)"), "Defense Evasion", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-enc|downloadstring|invoke-expression)"), "Execution", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(net\s+(user|group|share|view)|nltest|dsquery|whoami|systeminfo)"), "Discovery", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(psexec|wmic.*process.*call|winrm)"), "Lateral Movement", EventCode=7045 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4732, "Persistence", EventCode=13 AND match(TargetObject,"(?i)(Run|RunOnce|Services)"), "Persistence", 1=1, "skip") | where tactic!="skip" | timechart span=1h count by tactic

index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ | eval severity=case( EventCode=10 AND match(TargetImage,"(?i)lsass"), "Critical", match(CommandLine,"(?i)(sekurlsa|comsvcs|mimikatz|secretsdump|pypykatz|nanodump)"), "Critical", EventCode=4662 AND match(Properties,"1131f6a"), "Critical", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)reg\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(save|export).*(sam|system|security)"), "Critical", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-enc|downloadstring|invoke-webrequest)"), "High", EventCode=1 AND match(Image,"(?i)(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|certutil)\.exe") AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(http|decode|javascript|scrobj)"), "High", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(psexec|wmic.*process.*call|winrm)"), "High", EventCode=7045, "High", EventCode=4625, "Medium", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(net\s+(user|group|share)|nltest|whoami|systeminfo)"), "Medium", EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4732, "Medium", EventCode=13 AND match(TargetObject,"(?i)(Run|RunOnce)"), "Medium", 1=1, "skip") | where severity!="skip" | stats count by severity | eval sort_order=case(severity="Critical",1,severity="High",2,severity="Medium",3,severity="Low",4) | sort sort_order | fields - sort_order

panel.title: Saved Search / Alert Health — Scheduled Searches

search.query: | rest /services/saved/searches splunk_server=local | where is_scheduled=1 | eval status=case( disabled=1,"DISABLED", match(qualifiedSearch,"error"),"ERROR", 1=1,"ACTIVE") | eval last_run=strftime(strptime(updated,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"),"%m/%d %H:%M") | table title cron_schedule dispatch.earliest_time status last_run alert.severity actions | rename title as "Search Name", cron_schedule as "Schedule", dispatch.earliest_time as "Window", status as "Status", last_run as "Last Updated", alert.severity as "Severity", actions as "Actions" | sort Status, "Search Name"

panel.title: Potential False Positives — High Volume Single-Host Detections

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=7 OR EventCode=10 OR EventCode=11 OR EventCode=13 OR EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4662 OR EventCode=7045) | eval rule=case( EventCode=10 AND match(TargetImage,"(?i)lsass"), "LSASS Access", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-enc|-encodedcommand)"), "Encoded PS", EventCode=1 AND match(CommandLine,"(?i)(net\s+(user|group|localgroup|share|view|session))"), "Net Enum", EventCode=13 AND match(TargetObject,"(?i)(Run|RunOnce)"), "Registry Run", EventCode=7045, "New Service", EventCode=4625, "Failed Login", EventCode=11, "File Create", EventCode=3, "Net Connect", 1=1, "skip") | where rule!="skip" | stats count dc(host) as host_spread by rule host | where count > 50 AND host_spread=1 | eval fp_indicator=case(count>500,"LIKELY FP",count>100,"REVIEW",1=1,"POSSIBLE") | sort -count | head 15 | table rule host count fp_indicator | rename rule as "Detection", host as "Single Host", count as "Fire Count", fp_indicator as "FP Indicator"

panel.title: Detection Coverage Gaps — EventCodes With Zero Hits

search.query: | makeresults | eval EventCode="1,3,7,10,11,13,4624,4625,4648,4662,4688,4720,4732,7036,7045" | makemv EventCode delim="," | mvexpand EventCode | eval label=case( EventCode=1,"Sysmon Process Create", EventCode=3,"Sysmon Network Connect", EventCode=7,"Sysmon Image Load", EventCode=10,"Sysmon Process Access", EventCode=11,"Sysmon File Create", EventCode=13,"Sysmon Registry Value Set", EventCode=4624,"Logon Success", EventCode=4625,"Logon Failure", EventCode=4648,"Explicit Credential Logon", EventCode=4662,"Directory Service Access", EventCode=4688,"Process Create (native)", EventCode=4720,"User Account Created", EventCode=4732,"Member Added to Group", EventCode=7036,"Service State Change", EventCode=7045,"New Service Installed") | map maxsearches=15 search="| tstats count where index=$idx$ EventCode=$$EventCode$$ | eval EventCode=\"$$EventCode$$\", label=\"$$label$$\"" | where count=0 | table EventCode label | rename EventCode as "EventCode", label as "Description"

panel.title: LSASS Access Deep Dive — SourceImage x GrantedAccess (Sysmon EventCode 10)

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" | stats count by SourceImage GrantedAccess Computer | eval suspicious=case( match(GrantedAccess,"(0x1010|0x1410|0x1438|0x143a|0x1fffff|0x1f0fff)"),"YES", 1=1,"NO") | sort -count | head 25 | table Computer SourceImage GrantedAccess count suspicious | rename Computer as "Host", SourceImage as "Source Process", GrantedAccess as "Access Mask", count as "Count", suspicious as "Suspicious"

panel.title: Suspicious Process Executions — LOLBins & Credential Tools

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ EventCode=1 (Image="*\\rundll32.exe" OR Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" OR Image="*\\mshta.exe" OR Image="*\\certutil.exe" OR Image="*\\cscript.exe" OR Image="*\\wscript.exe" OR Image="*\\msbuild.exe" OR Image="*\\installutil.exe" OR Image="*\\bitsadmin.exe" OR Image="*\\wmic.exe") | eval process_name=replace(Image,".*\\\\","") | stats count values(CommandLine) as sample_cmds dc(Computer) as hosts by process_name User | sort -count | head 15 | eval sample_cmds=mvindex(sample_cmds,0,2) | table process_name User count hosts sample_cmds | rename process_name as "LOLBin", User as "User", count as "Executions", hosts as "Hosts", sample_cmds as "Sample Commands"

panel.title: Ingestion Health — Events Per Host Over Time

search.query: index=$idx$ host=$host_filter$ | timechart span=1h count by host limit=15
